name: Build Debian Packages

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/build_deb.yml
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  DEBIAN_FRONTEND: noninteractive
  VERSION: ${{ github.ref_name }}

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            build-essential cmake git patchelf \
            libssl-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev \
            libavformat-dev libavcodec-dev libavutil-dev \
            libswscale-dev libswresample-dev libavdevice-dev libavfilter-dev

      - name: Build GPAC (abi-16.4)
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 --branch abi-16.4 https://github.com/gpac/gpac.git
          mkdir -p build-gpac
          cd build-gpac
          cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr
          make -j$(nproc)
          make install DESTDIR=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/gpac-install

      - name: Build CCExtractor Basic
        run: |
          mkdir -p build-basic
          cd build-basic
          cmake .. \
            -DWITH_GPAC=ON \
            -DWITH_FFMPEG=OFF \
            -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr
          make -j$(nproc)
          make install DESTDIR=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/basic-install

      - name: Build CCExtractor HardsubX
        run: |
          mkdir -p build-hardsubx
          cd build-hardsubx
          cmake .. \
            -DWITH_GPAC=ON \
            -DWITH_FFMPEG=ON \
            -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr
          make -j$(nproc)
          make install DESTDIR=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/hardsubx-install

      - name: Patch binaries rpath
        run: |
          for dir in basic-install hardsubx-install; do
            find $dir/usr/bin -type f -executable -exec patchelf --set-rpath /usr/lib/ccextractor {} \;
          done

      - name: Prepare Debian package for Basic
        run: |
          mkdir -p package-basic/DEBIAN
          cat > package-basic/DEBIAN/control <<EOF
          Package: ccextractor-basic
          Version: ${VERSION}
          Architecture: amd64
          Maintainer: CCExtractor <info@ccextractor.org>
          Depends: libssl1.1, libcurl4, libavformat58, libavcodec58, libavutil56, libswscale5, libswresample3, libavdevice58, libavfilter7
          Recommends: libgpac1.0
          Description: CCExtractor Basic (OCR enabled)
          EOF
          cp -r basic-install/usr/* package-basic/
          dpkg-deb -b package-basic ccextractor-basic_${VERSION}_amd64.deb

      - name: Prepare Debian package for HardsubX
        run: |
          mkdir -p package-hardsubx/DEBIAN
          cat > package-hardsubx/DEBIAN/control <<EOF
          Package: ccextractor-hardsubx
          Version: ${VERSION}
          Architecture: amd64
          Maintainer: CCExtractor <info@ccextractor.org>
          Depends: libssl1.1, libcurl4, libavformat58, libavcodec58, libavutil56, libswscale5, libswresample3, libavdevice58, libavfilter7
          Recommends: libgpac1.0
          Description: CCExtractor HardsubX (FFmpeg enabled)
          EOF
          cp -r hardsubx-install/usr/* package-hardsubx/
          dpkg-deb -b package-hardsubx ccextractor-hardsubx_${VERSION}_amd64.deb

      - name: Upload Debian packages as artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ccextractor-deb
          path: |
            ccextractor-basic_${VERSION}_amd64.deb
            ccextractor-hardsubx_${VERSION}_amd64.deb

      - name: Upload Debian packages to release
        if: github.event_name == 'release' && github.event.action == 'published'
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ccextractor-basic_${VERSION}_amd64.deb
          asset_name: ccextractor-basic_${VERSION}_amd64.deb
          asset_content_type: application/vnd.debian.binary-package

      - name: Upload HardsubX Debian package to release
        if: github.event_name == 'release' && github.event.action == 'published'
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ccextractor-hardsubx_${VERSION}_amd64.deb
          asset_name: ccextractor-hardsubx_${VERSION}_amd64.deb
          asset_content_type: application/vnd.debian.binary-package
